Test Case Name: Test case to verify LED voltage of the Non-Driver PCB when LED connected
Pre Action:
1.Power Supply - ON
2.Connect LED between TP602 and GND
3.Connect the Trace32 hardware to the PC with  target board.
4.Run SmartBuApp.bat to open GUI Panel
5.Go to Section Setting
6.Click on Brouse option to select elf  > To Falsh elf
7.Select Variant - Non NFC Version
8.Click on Connect Trace32 and wait for connection
9.Click on Start Code (Go) and  verify Debugger Running
Test Steps:
1.Select Tab > LED
2.Select Led_On 
3.Click on Run Symbol
